title: The Gate Evaluation Committee
subtitle: The body that decides what happens at the Gates
summary: Founded by the University of Verna and now independent, with one member for each of the six powers, the Committee classifies every Gate, clears expeditions and orders quarantines.
content:
> *"The Committee never says yes. It says 'not yet', and then, eventually, 'cleared, subject to the above'."*
> — said among Expeditioners

The **Gate Evaluation Committee** decides what happens at the [[gates|Gates]]. It classifies every Gate, keeps the records, clears expeditions, restricts dangerous Gates and orders quarantines. If you've signed a manifest in [[endros|Endros]] or been asked whether you touched the Core, the Committee was behind it.

The University of Verna founded it, and for a while it was effectively a University committee. As the powers arrived in Endros, one university deciding who could enter a Gate became impossible to defend, so it was made independent. The exact terms and date aren't public.

It now seats **one member for each of the six powers**, Vardic, Aurelian, Vesperian, Kharadi, Tianzhao and Vernan, with a rotating chair. The members decide; the **evaluators** do the work: survey reports, Specimen examinations, classifications, clearance conditions and briefings. Evaluators come from every faction, hold no seat and have no vote, which, they'll tell you, is what lets them say unwelcome things. The best known is the Senior Evaluator, [Anselm Hartree](characters.html#anselm-hartree), who drafted the [[gate-evaluation-doctrine|Gate Evaluation Doctrine]].

The Committee prefers not to decide until no member objects strongly. That's slow, and it's also the point: a decision that survives the whole table is hard for any single power to call illegitimate. How votes are counted, and what happens if a power's government overrules its member, has never been publicly tested.

> **Minutes of the Gate Evaluation Committee (excerpt)**
>
> *The Aurelian member asked that the crew's manifests be filed in advance. Agreed. The Vesperian member asked that the findings be published in full; the Vernan member, that they not be published until reviewed. Deferred. The Kharadi member asked who would bear the cost of a second evacuation. No answer was recorded. The Vardic member asked when the crew could leave. Cleared, subject to the above.*
